$comment: Phase 0.1 Fast-tier elimination rubric. Timestamped at commit; no post-hoc edits per spec v16 §0.0a. Elimination-only: no scored ranking at this tier. See ADR-0007 for methodology.

rules.trigger: runtime fails to bring up model on target device

action.embedder: eliminate that (device, runtime) matrix cell only; other cells for the same model survive

rules.trigger: more than 1 task returns malformed output for the candidate

malformed_definition.coder: expected_tool_sequence not satisfied OR forbidden_tools invoked OR expected_output_contains missing OR expected_file_state divergent
malformed_definition.planner: output does not match tasks/planner-fast.json#/output_schema OR dependency graph is not a DAG OR truncated before valid JSON close
malformed_definition.embedder: any vector is null OR vector_min_norm violated OR identical_pair_min_cosine violated OR orthogonal_pair_max_cosine violated

rules.denominator_rule: malformed tasks stay in denominator; do not drop from rate metrics
rules.schema_field: category_1.malformed_call_rate for coder/planner; category_2 for planner rubric-score/verdict

rules.trigger: candidate wall-time or per-call warm latency exceeds 5x the fastest candidate on the same task
rules.action: flag for Medium-tier confirmation; do NOT eliminate at Fast tier unless R1 or R2 also fires
rules.offsetting_signal_exception: if the slow candidate produces materially better output on any Medium-tier-visible dimension, the flag stands but is annotated 'quality-offsets-latency'

rules.trigger: R1 fires AND the same model previously launched successfully under an older cached runtime version
rules.action: label the elimination 'runtime-version regression' distinct from 'model-candidate failure'; treat as infrastructure work item, not evidence against the model

scoring.reason: Fast tier is elimination-only per spec §0.1. Perplexity-gold-standard scoring first applies at Medium tier (§0.2) and is locked by a future ADR before first Medium-tier scored output.

post_hoc_edit_policy.note: Any change to this file after the first Fast-tier scored/eliminated run requires a superseding ADR.
